info.name: Amoeba API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for Amoeba API mounted routes.

1. Set `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:3001)
2. Run **Register (TEST_EMAIL bypass)** or **Login** to populate `accessToken` and `refreshToken`
3. Protected routes require both Authorization and refreshtoken headers

request.description: Uses TEST_EMAIL env bypass when email matches server TEST_EMAIL.
